name: Wine Cellar Manager
author: Matteo Enna

sections.description:
Wine Cellar Manager is a WordPress plugin designed to help you manage your wine inventory. With this plugin, you can easily add, filter, and display your wine collection using a custom post type and custom taxonomies.

Features

  • Custom Post Type for Wines
  • Custom Taxonomies for Regions, Grapes, and Wineries
  • Custom fields for managing wine details such as alcohol content, vintage, public price, quantity, and status
  • Public display of wines with filtering options
  • Admin settings page to configure the number of wines displayed per page
  • Easy to use shortcode to embed wine list in posts or pages

Usage

To display the wine list with filtering options, use the following shortcode in any post or page:

[wine_list_with_filters]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wine-cellar-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the [wine_list_with_filters] shortcode to display the wine list on your desired page.
  4. Configure the settings under “Settings” > “Wine Cellar Manager”.
